title: oldenlandia quadrangularis
intro: Oldenlandia quadrangularis, commonly known as Four Angle Plant or Qing Dai, is a type of flowering plant in the Rubiaceae family that is native to Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and act as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Oldenlandia quadrangularis include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic properties, which make it useful in treating conditions such as fever, cough, and respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
